description: This file defines the implementation of the SchemefulSite class, which manages origin and scheme-related operations, including obtaining site information, serialization, deserialization, and comparisons within the net namespace.

classes.name: SchemefulSite
classes.description: Represents a site with scheme and origin information, providing methods for obtaining site details, serialization, deserialization, and comparison operations.

methods.name: ObtainASite
methods.description: Returns a tuple with a normalized origin based on the registerable domain of the input origin, following the HTML specification steps.

methods.name: CreateIfHasRegisterableDomain
methods.description: Creates a SchemefulSite if the origin has a registerable domain.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Creates a SchemefulSite from a string representation.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the SchemefulSite to a string.

methods.name: SerializeFileSiteWithHost
methods.description: Serializes the site with host information, specifically for file scheme origins.

methods.name: GetDebugString
methods.description: Returns a debug string representing the site.

methods.name: GetURL
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the site.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between two SchemefulSite instances.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality between two SchemefulSite instances.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Provides ordering comparison for SchemefulSite instances.

methods.name: DeserializeWithNonce
methods.description: Deserializes a SchemefulSite from a string with nonce support.

methods.name: SerializeWithNonce
methods.description: Serializes the site with a nonce.

methods.name: SchemelesslyEqual
methods.description: Checks if two sites are equal ignoring the scheme, comparing only host.
